function.name: check_table_availability
function.description: Check table availability for a new Ember & Vine reservation. Call only when the calendar date, requested local time, and party size are known and unambiguous. Call again if any of those values changes. The tool returns whether the requested time is available and, when unavailable, up to two alternatives.

reservationDate.description: Reservation calendar date in YYYY-MM-DD format. Do not call while the caller's relative date is ambiguous.

requestedTime.description: Requested restaurant-local time in 24-hour HH:mm format.
